20d

When the work function is decreased, the incident photons need to have less kinetic energy in order for photoelectrons to be emitted.

To have photons with less energy, their frequency should be decreased/wavelength increased.

This can be achieved by shifting the colour of the incident light towards the red end of the visible spectrum.

question.html:
Monochromatic light is incident on a metal surface and photoelectrons are emitted from the surface. The metal has a work function of J.

a. State what work function means.

  [1]

b. Outline why photoelectrons are only emitted from the metal surface above a certain frequency of the incident light.

  [2]

c. The maximum momentum of the emitted photoelectrons is kg m s. Calculate the wavelength of the incident light.

  [4]

d. The work function of the metal is decreased. Outline how the colour of the incident light should be changed in order to keep the momentum of the emitted photoelectrons the same as in question part (c).
